title: Parts & Service applies no product-type filter
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Sales By Customer report with both S and P invoices in the date range.
custom_steps:
1. Set Product Type to "Parts only" and note the visible customers/totals.
2. Set Product Type back to "Parts & Service."
custom_expected: 1. With "Parts & Service" selected, no product-type filter is applied — both S and P invoices are included again and counts/totals cover both.
